claims.statement: The reviewed sources do not establish an AI-word blacklist or blanket exclusion of AI-assisted writing.
claims.limit: This review does not reveal every proprietary ranking signal or diagnose this site.

claims.statement: Scaled unoriginal content primarily made to manipulate rankings may violate spam policy regardless of production method.
Accurate bylines, author background, and an explanation of how content was produced help readers assess the publication.
claims.limit: The prohibition on fabricated identities, credentials, and experience is stated separately as our editorial application.

claims.statement: Check accuracy and relevance, including titles, descriptions, structured data, and image text.
Explain decision factors and tradeoffs with original supporting evidence; length alone does not establish review quality.
Discovery, crawling, indexing, and serving are separate; an indexed page may still fail to appear for a query.
Google eligibility requires crawler access, successful HTTP delivery, and indexable content; robots blocking is distinct from noindex.
claims.limit: Meeting technical requirements does not guarantee indexing.

claims.statement: AI supporting links require indexing and snippet eligibility; no special AI file or structured-data type is required.
Visible and structured dates should agree and describe actual page publication or update, not a future date or the event described.
Bing identifies low-value automation, scraping, thin affiliates, artificial promotion, misleading markup, and prompt manipulation as risks.
claims.limit: Guidelines do not guarantee rankings or grounding citations.

claims.statement: OAI-SearchBot concerns search; GPTBot concerns training. ChatGPT-User is user-triggered and does not control Search inclusion.
claims.limit: Independent bot preferences are not ranking guarantees.

claims.statement: New independent training and grounding preferences were announced October 30, 2026; honoring begins February 1, 2027.
claims.limit: Traditional Bing search eligibility remains separate; do not describe the controls as already effective.

editorialPolicies.rule: Owner-authorized first-person drafting may express approved views and background. It cannot manufacture product use, tests, customers, revenue, or credentials. Require separate factual evidence for such statements.
Keep documentation review, recommendation, synthetic example, proposed trial, and completed demonstration distinct. Site software verification is not vendor product testing.
Identify original source and purpose of vendor images. A documentation screenshot is not evidence of operating our own account. Label synthetic illustrations and examples.
Preserve original publication history. Record real source checks and material changes. A routine rebuild does not justify presenting old material as newly researched.
Record contradictory documentation, scope the instruction to verified facts, and reconcile dependent catalog and comparison copy. Unknown price is not zero.
Each substantial guide should let a reader complete a meaningful job through reusable inputs, worked outputs, explicit decisions, checks, or recovery steps.
